name: Aged Gorilla Sinew
summary: Aged Gorilla Sinew comes from Elder Mistvale Gorillas east of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. Far Seer Mok'thardin needs one as a magical tether for his work.

sections.title: A Magical Tether
sections.body: East of Booty Bay, Elder Mistvale Gorillas forage in the jungle. Far Seer Mok'thardin needs an aged sinew from one of them to bind feathers, claws, and a pristine fang in place. The sinew must be perfect, so finding one may take patience.

faq.q: Where can I find Aged Gorilla Sinew?
faq.answer: Elder Mistvale Gorillas forage east of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale, and one may yield an aged sinew.
Far Seer Mok'thardin in Grom'gol needs an Aged Gorilla Sinew as a magical tether.

faq.q: What is the sinew used for?
faq.answer: Mok'thardin uses the sinew to hold feathers, claws, and a pristine fang in place.

faq.q: Why must the sinew be perfect?
faq.answer: Mok'thardin requires a perfect sinew for his magical tether.
